name: How long does a typical rental unit make-ready take in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical rental unit make-ready take in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a rental unit make-ready varies significantly based on the unit's size, condition, and the scope of work required. A light refresh might take a few days, while a unit requiring extensive repairs, painting, or flooring replacement could take one to two weeks or longer. Simply Construction provides a detailed timeline after assessing the property. Our goal is efficient completion to minimize vacancy periods for property owners in Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, Henderson, and Paradise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Make-ready times vary from a few days to over two weeks, depending on the unit's size and required work.
